title: Book One · Chapter 150: Four Legs and One Yes
story:
Ronan brings Dad the stool drawing after breakfast. There are three lines under it. OUR KITCHEN STOOL. ONE LEG WAS LOOSE. DAD REPAIRED IT.

Dad reads them. He turns the paper over and looks at the back. The back is empty.

“That is all?”

“I wrote only those three lines.”

Dad looks at the real stool. Mum is sitting on it, tying the end of a thread.

“What would visitors do with it?”

“Look at it. Perhaps sit, if you say it is safe.”

“Not a whole class climbing on it.”

Ronan shakes his head. “Only one person at a time. Miss Wu can choose its place.”

“And you would not put the old shop card beside it?”

“No.”

Dad waits. Ronan lets him. He can hear a spoon tapping a bowl in Mrs Lan's room. He can hear Mum pull her thread through the cloth. Mum keeps sewing. Ronan waits. He asks no more questions.

“Yes to the stool,” Dad says at last. “Ask your mother too. She uses it.”

Mum lifts her sewing. “It can visit school for one afternoon. Then it comes home.”

Ronan grins. He writes that at the bottom of the sheet. Dad adds a small line to the drawing. It shows the leg and the seat together. This is his first mark on a display picture.

Ronan wants to read the lines before he leaves. He turns the paper over. He tries to say all three lines himself. Dad asks him to look anyway. Ronan looks at the real words. Did he say the words right? He checks the card. Ronan missed the word “kitchen.” He puts it back when he reads again. It is their kitchen stool. He reads those words again, with his finger under them.

At school Miss Wu looks at the drawing and the agreed words. She likes a real working object. But people must not trip over the stool. It needs a place away from the door. She places its paper shape beside the resting chair on the room plan.

“An adult must bring it and take it back,” she says.

“I can carry it.”

“You will have other things to carry. We need a clear plan.”

Ronan nods and writes MUM? beside the carrying line. He must ask Mum first. Then he can put her name there. She may have other work that afternoon.

Leo studies the stool picture. “It looks like four number ones holding a box.”

“Four legs hold it up,” Ronan says.

Mei draws the seat at a small angle on a separate sheet. She draws the far legs a little shorter. The real legs are the same length. But in the picture, shorter lines make them look farther away. Ronan tries it. The second drawing looks like a real stool.

He keeps Dad's drawing too. They will show the plain real stool, with the little repair card. The new picture shows the part under the seat. Visitors can look at the drawing. They can leave the stool upright.

At home he reads the whole plan back to Dad. Dad changes one word. “Please do not call me a master,” he says.

“Just Dad?”

“Your dad. I repair things.”

Ronan writes the words. Mum agrees to help carry the stool. But she cannot take every picture and bag too. They divide the list. Ronan writes a name beside each thing. Mum will not have to carry everything herself.

---

重点表达：repair＝修理；trip over＝被绊倒；divide＝分开、分配。

情节提示：angle＝角度；master＝大师；upright＝正放。

理解：1. Dad 同意借凳子时明确了什么界限？2. 为什么还需要专门安排搬运？
